title: Swift Pay
description: A modern payment gateway inspired by Razorpay, supporting merchant onboarding, API key management, secure payment processing, subscriptions, refunds, settlements, webhooks, JWT authentication, and role-based access control. Built with a scalable FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL.

title: AI Image Analyzer
description: An AI-powered image analysis application using Google's Gemini Vision model. Users can upload images and receive intelligent descriptions, object detection, scene understanding, and contextual analysis through a FastAPI backend.

title: Trackify
description: A productivity and project tracking application built with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. It helps users organize tasks, monitor progress, manage deadlines, and improve productivity through a clean dashboard and RESTful APIs.
